Both are J = 1 resonance levels whose NIST A values to the ground state are 3.13e8 and 2.70e8 s^-1 (natural lifetime of a few ns), so the 61 ns figures are radiation-trapped cascade lifetimes at 2-3000 Torr and were NOT stored as level lifetimes.
